Despite the small number of high-level actions, skill transitions give rise to emergent combo behaviors, expanding expressivity beyond individual primitives. Across Ant, Franka-arm, and Unitree G1 environments, we show that GGSD produces human-playable skills that humans can compose to solve unseen tasks, such as Maze and CubePush, without additional training. An interactive demo is available at https://ggsd-demo.github.io.
translation:
标题：通过自博弈实现游戏引导式技能发现：面向可玩的智能体控制

摘要：我们提出游戏引导的技能发现（Game-Guided Skill Discovery, GGSD）框架，该框架利用游戏中的自博弈来发现可供人类直接操控的运动技能。可玩技能通过一小组学习到的行为而非低级动作，为控制具身智能体提供了一种紧凑的抽象。为了有效，这些技能应具有语义区分性、可解释性和表达力；现有无监督技能发现方法通常难以同时实现这些性质。GGSD 通过将技能发现建立在竞争性游戏玩法之上来实现这些目标。一个分层智能体与其过去的自身进行竞争，其中高层策略从一小组离散技能中选择，技能条件化的低层策略学习相应行为。训练后，人类可以替换高层策略，并通过相同的离散技能直接控制智能体。尽管高层动作数量很少，技能转换会产生涌现的连招行为，从而将表现力扩展到单个原语之外。在 Ant、Franka 机械臂和 Unitree G1 环境中，我们表明 GGSD 能生成人类可玩的技能，人类无需额外训练即可组合这些技能来解决未见任务，例如 Maze 和 CubePush。交互式演示见 https://ggsd-demo.github.io。

title: WUSH-KV: KV Cache Quantization with Data-Adaptive Transforms
summary: KV cache memory and bandwidth costs grow with context length and batch size, which limits efficient long-context inference. To address this bottleneck, we introduce WUSH-KV for low-bit KV-cache quantization. It adapts WUSH, which constructs a data-aware transform from the second-order statistics of both factors in a matrix product to reduce quantization error. WUSH-KV uses calibration data to construct separate key and value transforms, with the value transform folded into the model weights and the key transform applied after RoPE. The transforms can be paired with clipped quantizers. For one such quantizer, QuEST INT, we show that, under mild assumptions, the WUSH transform is near-optimal. With this quantizer, WUSH-KV reduces layerwise reconstruction error and achieves the lowest end-to-end perplexity among other tested transforms. For end-to-end evaluation, we integrate WUSH-KV into SGLang using OSCAR-style percentile-clipped affine quantization. At 2-bit, WUSH-KV performs comparably to or outperforms the OSCAR transform across all evaluated models and downstream tasks.
translation:
标题：WUSH-KV：基于数据自适应变换的 KV 缓存量化

摘要：KV 缓存的内存和带宽开销会随上下文长度和批量大小增长，从而限制高效的长上下文推理。为解决这一瓶颈，我们提出 WUSH-KV，用于低比特 KV 缓存量化。它采用 WUSH，后者利用矩阵乘积中两个因子的二阶统计量构建数据感知变换，以降低量化误差。WUSH-KV 使用校准数据分别构建键和值变换，其中值变换被折叠进模型权重，键变换在 RoPE 之后应用。这些变换可与裁剪量化器配合使用。对于其中一种量化器 QuEST INT，我们证明，在温和假设下，WUSH 变换接近最优。使用该量化器时，WUSH-KV 降低了逐层重建误差，并在其他测试变换中实现了最低的端到端困惑度。在端到端评估中，我们使用 OSCAR 风格的百分位裁剪仿射量化将 WUSH-KV 集成到 SGLang 中。在 2 比特下，WUSH-KV 在所有评估模型和下游任务上与 OSCAR 变换表现相当或更优。

title: CUA-SWE: When Computer-Use Agents Meet Visual Software Engineering
summary: Software development requires more than editing code: developers repeatedly run software, interact with its interfaces, visually inspect its behavior, and use these observations to decide what to change next and whether a change works. Existing coding agents and computer-use agents are largely studied in isolation, leaving this integrated development process underexplored. Diagnosing a runtime interaction failure requires agents to connect visual observations with the responsible code, then use the application again to verify the repair. We introduce CUA-SWE, a benchmark, environment, and evaluation pipeline for software engineering with computer use. Beyond studying how GUI feedback supports diagnosis and repair, we ask whether agents can complete software engineering tasks when required specification or operational information is available only through the running application's visual interface. CUA-SWE spans four software engineering domains and requires agents to modify code and configuration, execute commands, interact with running software, and inspect visual feedback within the same task. Each task includes deterministic, task-specific tests that verify whether the resulting software satisfies the requirements and preserves specified behavior. Our evaluation characterizes how frontier agents combine source-level execution with application screenshots and graphical interaction to produce verified software changes. We examine performance across domains and task information requirements, alongside the development behaviors associated with successful repairs. CUA-SWE provides a unified testbed for studying how agents use visual feedback and interaction to guide software engineering, with executable correctness criteria for the resulting software.
translation:
标题：CUA-SWE：当计算机使用智能体遇见视觉软件工程

摘要：软件开发所需的不仅仅是编辑代码：开发者会反复运行软件、与其界面交互、以视觉方式检查其行为，并利用这些观察来决定下一步修改什么以及某项修改是否有效。现有编码智能体和计算机使用智能体大多被孤立研究，导致这一集成开发过程尚未得到充分探索。诊断运行时交互故障要求智能体将视觉观察与应负责的代码关联起来，然后再次使用应用程序以验证修复。我们提出 CUA-SWE，一个面向结合计算机使用的软件工程的基准、环境与评估流水线。除了研究 GUI 反馈如何支持诊断与修复，我们还探究：当所需规范或操作信息仅能通过运行中应用程序的视觉界面获得时，智能体能否完成软件工程任务。CUA-SWE 涵盖四个软件工程领域，并要求智能体在同一任务中修改代码与配置、执行命令、与运行中的软件交互，并检查视觉反馈。每个任务都包含确定性的、任务特定的测试，用于验证所得软件是否满足需求并保持指定行为。我们的评估刻画了前沿智能体如何将源码级执行与应用程序截图及图形交互相结合，以产生经过验证的软件变更。我们考察了不同领域和任务信息需求下的性能，以及成功修复所伴随的开发行为。CUA-SWE 提供了一个统一的测试平台，用于研究智能体如何利用视觉反馈和交互来指导软件工程，并为所得软件提供可执行的正确性准则。

title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
summary: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.
translation:
标题：AdviSD：通过定向多轮自蒸馏学习为前沿大语言模型提供建议

摘要：一个小型可训练的顾问可以利用自然语言建议引导一个冻结的语言模型执行器。除了从任务奖励中学习外，顾问还可以利用已完成交互的反馈来改进其建议。然而，看似合理的纠正并不一定会改变执行，而从这类纠正中学习仍可能影响顾问在其他情境中的未来决策。在共享参数模型中，我们证明，如果这类纠正的目标相较其他纠正的目标对有用建议的偏好程度更弱，那么此类纠正可能限制学习。与从每个纠正中学习相比，相较于保留其他纠正，更少地保留这类纠正可提升模型最终性能。受此启发，我们的方法——顾问自蒸馏（AdviSD）——将基于结果的强化学习与选择性自蒸馏相结合，后者来自顾问的一个以反馈为条件的副本。反思提出纠正，顾问对同一记录的执行器响应在包含和不包含其给出的建议时进行评分，并利用差异幅度来选择用于监督的决策。该方法不需要执行器的似然度，也不需要额外的执行器 rollout。使用 Qwen3-8B 顾问为 Gemini 和 Claude 进行的实验表明，AdviSD 在 BFCL-v3 上比 advisor-GRPO 高出 4.2–6.4 个百分点，在 EnvScaler 上高出 3.9–5.1 分。训练后的顾问可泛化到域外任务，并能跨不同执行器版本和模型家族迁移。AdviSD 也优于数量匹配的随机选择，支持其选择规则的价值。

title: CoEvoWhen: Policy-Tool Coevolution for Ultra-Long Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Ultra-long video temporal grounding requires balancing long-range evidence search with fine-grained event understanding under a limited visual budget, yet existing agentic methods still rely largely on predefined policies and tool capabilities. Motivated by this, we propose a novel policy-tool coevolution framework that jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from the agentic reasoning trajectories of a VLM, forming a reusable skill without updating model parameters. During evolution, an external skill updater distills transferable task experience in long-video temporal grounding, accordingly refining the orchestration of long-range image-based and fine-grained video-based observations. Alongside these policy updates, the updater employs its coding capabilities to upgrade existing tools or create new ones, adapting the tools to long-video evidence acquisition. Equipped with the evolved skill, the VLM autonomously orchestrates tools under the guidance of the evolved policy, coordinating image and video observations for agentic inference without relying on a separate, stronger planning model. Extensive experiments spanning five benchmarks and three VLMs show that policy-tool coevolution consistently improves temporal grounding accuracy in ultra-long videos while reducing visual token cost at inference, and that the evolved skill yields substantial performance gains on general long-video QA without additional task-specific evolution, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework for long-video understanding.
translation:
标题：CoEvoWhen：面向超长视频时序定位的策略-工具协同演化

摘要：超长视频时序定位需要在有限视觉预算下平衡长程证据搜索与细粒度事件理解，然而现有智能体方法仍主要依赖预定义的策略和工具能力。受此启发，我们提出了一种新颖的策略-工具协同演化框架，该框架从视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体推理轨迹中联合演化高层策略与可执行媒体工具，形成一种可复用技能，且无需更新模型参数。在演化过程中，外部技能更新器蒸馏长视频时序定位中的可迁移任务经验，并据此优化对长程基于图像的观测与细粒度基于视频的观测的编排。伴随这些策略更新，更新器利用其编码能力升级现有工具或创建新工具，使工具适应长视频证据获取。借助演化后的技能，VLM 在演化策略的指导下自主编排工具，协调图像与视频观测以进行智能体推理，而无需依赖单独的、更强的规划模型。涵盖五个基准和三种 VLM 的大量实验表明，策略-工具协同演化在超长视频中持续提升时序定位精度，同时降低推理时的视觉 token 成本；并且演化后的技能在无需额外任务特定演化的情况下，在通用长视频问答上取得显著性能提升，证明了我们的框架在长视频理解方面的有效性与泛化能力。

title: Not Every Token Is Worth Distilling: Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD
summary: Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD) transfers reinforcement-learning-induced policy improvements from a small model to a larger student by using the token-level log-ratio between post-RL and pre-RL checkpoints as dense supervision on the student's own rollouts. This transfer rewards the policy shift at every state, yet the log-ratio measures only relative change: it can stay fixed even as the probability mass that both checkpoints assign to the student's candidate tokens vanishes. Through an exact construction, we show that the Direct-OPD reward and its update can remain unchanged while the Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) and both KL directions between the checkpoints vanish with this mass, and we note that a small JSD bounds how much the teacher's behavior changed. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD (S^2D-OPD), which ranks student-sampled states by their teacher-reference JSD and masks Direct-OPD supervision at low-divergence states, retaining only the top 10% of states per response. Across two teacher pairs and four student models ranging from 1.7B to 8B parameters, S^2D-OPD improves held-out accuracy over dense Direct-OPD on AIME and HMMT benchmarks in seven of eight settings and matches it in the eighth, without extra forward passes.
translation:
标题：并非每个词元都值得蒸馏：面向 Direct-OPD 的选择性监督

摘要：直接同策略蒸馏（Direct On-Policy Distillation，Direct-OPD）通过使用强化学习后与强化学习前检查点之间的词元级对数比，作为对学生自身采样轨迹的稠密监督，将强化学习带来的策略改进从一个小模型迁移到一个更大的学生模型。这种迁移会奖励每个状态下的策略偏移，但对数比仅衡量相对变化：即使两个检查点分配给学生的候选词元的概率质量消失，它也可以保持不变。通过一个精确构造，我们表明：当检查点之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度（JSD）和两个 KL 方向随该概率质量一起消失时，Direct-OPD 奖励及其更新可以保持不变；并且我们指出，较小的 JSD 限制了教师行为的变化幅度。受此分析启发，我们提出了面向 Direct-OPD 的选择性监督（Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD，S²D-OPD），它根据学生采样状态相对于教师参考的 JSD 对这些状态进行排序，并在低散度状态下屏蔽 Direct-OPD 监督，每个回答仅保留排名前 10% 的状态。在两组教师配对和四个参数规模从 1.7B 到 8B 的学生模型上，S²D-OPD 在 AIME 和 HMMT 基准上，在八种设置中的七种里相较于密集 Direct-OPD 提高了留出准确率，并在第八种中与之持平，且无需额外的前向传播。

title: Mitigating the Length-Scaling Tax with Online Distillation
summary: Length scaling during reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training is often viewed as a sign of improved reasoning ability, especially on difficult problems, but may also make responses to already-solved problems unnecessarily verbose. We quantify this side effect as the length-scaling tax (LST): excess response length on already-solved queries without a commensurate accuracy gain. To mitigate LST, we propose Length Self-Distillation (LSD), which routes solved prompts to on-policy distillation and retains the original RL objective for unsolved prompts. LSD uses an exponential moving average of the online policy as its teacher, requiring no external model. We find that LSD achieves comparable or better performance than RL across multiple variants, while substantially curbing response-length growth on easy queries. LSD reduces LST from 19.0% to -3.7% on single-turn reasoning and from 31.4% to 13.7% on multi-turn agentic tasks, demonstrating that LSD effectively preserves concise response patterns on easy queries while supporting efficient exploration on difficult queries during RL post-training.
translation:
标题：通过在线蒸馏缓解长度缩放代价  
摘要：在强化学习（RL）后训练期间，长度缩放通常被视为推理能力提升的标志，尤其是在困难问题上，但它也可能使对已解决查询的响应变得不必要地冗长。我们将这一副作用量化为长度缩放代价（LST）：在已解决查询上产生多余的响应长度，却未带来相称的准确率增益。为缓解 LST，我们提出长度自蒸馏（LSD），该方法将已解决提示路由至同策略蒸馏，并对未解决提示保留原始 RL 目标。LSD 使用在线策略的指数移动平均作为教师模型，无需外部模型。我们发现，LSD 在多个变体中取得与 RL 相当或更优的性能，同时显著抑制简单查询上的响应长度增长。LSD 将单轮推理中的 LST 从 19.0% 降至 -3.7%，并将多轮智能体任务中的 LST 从 31.4% 降至 13.7%，表明 LSD 在 RL 后训练期间能有效保持简单查询上的简洁响应模式，同时支持困难查询上的高效探索。

title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
summary: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this question, we pretrain 800 language models, varying the ratio of added AI tokens to human tokens, and fit scaling laws to held-out losses on both human and AI-generated text. For data-starved models, adding AI tokens to pretraining data initially lowers loss on human text, but the benefit saturates as more are added and quickly *reverses* into harm. For models trained on high budgets of human text, AI tokens raise loss almost immediately, while the same number of fresh human tokens keeps lowering it. Scaling laws such as Hoffman et al. (2022) fail to predict this behavior. We propose a new scaling law with separate benefit and harm terms that allows the value of an AI token to change sign while also reducing to Chinchilla in the absence of AI text. When fit on smaller models, our scaling law predicts the effect of AI text on held-out human-text loss for models up to 3.6x larger with 41% lower error than the best existing law over all AI ratios. We recommend filtering AI text when the target is human text, repeating human text before expanding the training dataset with AI-generated web text, and reporting validation loss on human and AI text separately AI text remains valuable when the target is AI text. We release WildAI, an 83B-token corpus with AI, topic, and format labels, all 800 models and code at https://github.com/pangramlabs/WildAI.
translation:
标题：一个 AI 词元价值几何？野生 AI 生成网页文本的缩放定律

摘要：网页文本构成了预训练数据的大部分，并且越来越多地由 AI 生成。在应用 FineWeb 质量过滤后，我们发现，2026 年 6 月网页数据中有 27.5% 的词元被 Pangram 标注为 AI 生成，到 8 月这一比例升至 31.1%。与合成数据或模型崩溃场景不同，这种“野生”AI 文本来自众多模型，是为人类读者编写的，并以未标注形式进入预训练语料库。野生 AI 文本会如何影响语言模型预训练？为回答这一问题，我们预训练了 800 个语言模型，改变所加入 AI 词元与人类词元的比例，并分别在人类文本与 AI 生成文本的留出集上拟合缩放定律。对于数据匮乏的模型，向预训练数据中加入 AI 词元最初会降低人类文本上的损失，但随着加入更多词元，收益会饱和，并迅速逆转为有害。对于以高人类文本预算训练的模型，AI 词元几乎立即会提高损失，而同等数量的新鲜人类词元则持续降低损失。Hoffman 等人（2022）等缩放定律无法预测这种行为。我们提出一种新的缩放定律，包含独立的收益项和危害项，允许 AI 词元的价值改变符号，同时在无 AI 文本时退化为 Chinchilla。当在较小模型上拟合时，我们的缩放定律可预测 AI 文本对留出人类文本损失的影响，对于规模最多为其 3.6 倍的模型，在所有 AI 比例下，其误差比现有最佳定律低 41%。当目标为人类文本时，我们建议过滤 AI 文本；在利用 AI 生成网页文本扩展训练数据集之前，重复人类文本；并分别报告人类文本和 AI 文本上的验证损失。当目标为 AI 文本时，AI 文本仍有价值。我们发布 WildAI，一个 830 亿词元、带有 AI、主题和格式标签的语料库，以及全部 800 个模型和代码，见 https://github.com/pangramlabs/WildAI。

title: LEAP: Learned Block-wise Evidence Retrieval for Long Audio-Video Perception
summary: Hour-scale audio-visual question answering is constrained by a context dilemma: dense whole-recording encoding rapidly exhausts context limits, whereas uniform temporal compression severely dilutes fine-grained acoustic and visual evidence. We introduce LEAP, a framework where the model retrieves its own evidence without placing the whole recording in one context. LEAP divides a recording into fixed-duration blocks, applying a lightweight localization pass to each block to score short candidate windows. The highest-ranked windows are pooled and re-encoded in a single bounded answer pass. Consequently, the answer input and peak context remain independent of the recording duration. By decoupling evidence localization from reasoning, our framework can localize candidate temporal windows over pre-computed transcripts without decoding media frames, while preserving fine-grained visual and non-speech evidence by routing the final answering pass over raw audio-visual streams. LEAP trains both stages: a localization LoRA improves the selected windows, and an answer LoRA improves the answers read from the same windows. The block grid natively supports causal queries, enabling LEAP to support streaming inference without streaming-specific training. Across several AVQA benchmarks, LEAP improves over the Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B baseline by 4.5-16.8%, and transfers to a second omni-modal backbone, MiniCPM-o 4.5, surpassing its published results by 3.1-13.0%.
translation:
标题：LEAP：面向长音视频感知的学习式分块证据检索

摘要：小时级音视频问答受困于一种上下文困境：对整个录制内容进行密集编码会迅速耗尽上下文限制，而均匀的时间压缩又会严重稀释细粒度的声学与视觉证据。我们提出LEAP，一个无需将整段录制内容放入单个上下文即可让模型检索自身证据的框架。LEAP将录制内容划分为固定时长的块，对每个块应用轻量级定位过程，为短候选窗口打分。排名最高的窗口被汇集，并在单次有界答案过程中重新编码。因此，答案输入和峰值上下文保持与录制时长无关。通过将证据定位与推理解耦，我们的框架可以在预计算的转录文本上定位候选时间窗口，而无需解码媒体帧，同时通过将最终答案过程路由到原始音视频流上来保留细粒度的视觉和非语音证据。LEAP对两个阶段都进行训练：定位LoRA改进所选窗口，答案LoRA改进从相同窗口读取的答案。块网格原生支持因果查询，使LEAP无需流式专用训练即可支持流式推理。在多个AVQA基准上，LEAP相较Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B基线提升4.5%–16.8%，并迁移至第二个全模态骨干模型MiniCPM-o 4.5，超过其已发表结果3.1%–13.0%。

title: Removing Timing Shortcuts Improves Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
summary: We find that major reported improvements in decoding words from non-invasive brain recordings are largely reproducible without any brain data. In the influential work of d'Ascoli et al. (2025), time series of brain activity from subjects perceiving continuous speech are segmented into fixed-length windows starting at each word. A neural network then generates predictions for all of the words in a sentence together. Neighbouring windows partially overlap, implicitly revealing the interval between words. Since these intervals indicate the duration of the words spoken, and different words tend to have different durations - for example, "the" is much shorter than "supercalifragilisticexpialidocious" - the neural network can improve its predictions of words without relying on the underlying brain activity. Consistent with this, the method reaches 22.0% balanced accuracy on synthetic signals containing no brain information, compared with 22.3% on real brain recordings. To prevent the network from learning this shortcut, we make a single, simple change. Instead of jointly encoding all windows in a sentence, we process each independently. As a result, the neural network achieves better performance by learning underlying word-specific information from brain recordings. This makes two existing strategies become much more effective than before. Both aggregating predictions from distinct neural responses to the same word and using a pretrained LLM as a linguistic prior now substantially improve results. On our perceived speech benchmark, this simple recipe (SimpleB2T) achieves a word error rate of 36.6% with five observations per word, approaching past invasive speech decoding performance, albeit under different conditions. The results in this work expose an important shortcut in brain-to-text decoding and show that removing it leads to a simple and considerably more effective strategy.
translation:
标题：消除时间捷径可提升非侵入式脑到文本解码

摘要：我们发现，在从非侵入式脑记录解码单词方面所报道的主要改进，在很大程度上无需任何脑数据即可复现。在 d'Ascoli 等人（2025）具有影响力的工作中，受试者感知连续语音时的大脑活动时间序列被分割为从每个单词开始的固定长度窗口。随后，一个神经网络共同生成对句子中所有单词的预测。相邻窗口部分重叠，隐式地揭示了单词之间的间隔。由于这些间隔指示了所说单词的持续时间，而不同单词往往具有不同时长——例如，“the”比“supercalifragilisticexpialidocious”短得多——神经网络可以在不依赖底层大脑活动的情况下改进其对单词的预测。与此一致，该方法在不含任何脑信息的合成信号上达到 22.0% 的平衡准确率，而在真实脑记录上为 22.3%。为防止网络学习这一捷径，我们做了一个单一而简单的改动。我们不再联合编码句子中的所有窗口，而是独立处理每个窗口。结果，神经网络通过从脑记录中学习底层的单词特异性信息，取得了更好的性能。这使得两种现有策略比之前有效得多。现在，无论是将针对同一单词的不同神经响应的预测进行聚合，还是将预训练 LLM 用作语言先验，都显著改善了结果。在我们的感知语音基准上，这一简单方案（SimpleB2T）在每词五次观测下实现了 36.6% 的词错误率，接近以往侵入式语音解码的性能，尽管条件不同。本工作的结果揭示了脑到文本解码中的一个重要捷径，并表明消除该捷径可带来一种简单且明显更有效的策略。

title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation
summary: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B parameters across four skill-use benchmarks; Our Qwen3.5-9B SFT model outperforms the 397B untrained model on two of them. Further analysis shows that training teaches agents to invoke skills, raising the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%, and that the gains hold across reasoning structures, extending to task types that form a minority of the training data and to skills held out from training
translation:
标题：SkillGym：通过自动可验证的环境生成训练技能使用智能体

摘要：技能为LLM智能体提供专业知识和指导，以完成长时程复杂任务。尽管技能已在近期智能体范式和框架中被广泛采用，但如何合成可靠的训练数据以及如何训练智能体使用技能仍探索不足。在这项工作中，我们提出SkillGym，一个自动化流水线，用于构建可验证环境、收集轨迹并训练技能使用智能体。SkillGym首先从互联网爬取大量技能，然后保留那些工作流可在离线环境中可复现运行的技能。我们采用构建者-审查者流水线来构建难度受控的任务，涵盖四种任务类型，每个任务均带有参考解决方案和可执行验证器。借助该流水线，我们构建了6.8k个环境，并收集了19k条经过验证的成功轨迹用于监督微调。在这些轨迹上进行微调，可在四个技能使用基准上提升不同系列和规模（从2B到122B参数）的LLM；我们的Qwen3.5-9B SFT模型在其中两个基准上优于未经训练的397B模型。进一步分析表明，训练教会智能体调用技能，将阅读相关技能的比率从28%提升至96%，且这些增益在不同推理结构上均成立，并扩展到仅占训练数据少数的任务类型以及训练中留出的技能。

title: Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudolabels as rewards and optimizes only ~100K bias parameters while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. On MATH-500, our approach reaches 76.67% accuracy with Qwen2.5-7B, slightly exceeding our own labeled bias-steering reproduction while optimizing 76,000x fewer parameters than full-parameter TTRL. The same training procedure improves performance across vision-language and audio reasoning tasks, including MathVista, AI2D, LogicVista, and MMAU. We further show that the learned steering vectors transfer to 4,500 held-out MATH problems, indicating that the adaptation is not limited to the problems used during test-time optimization. Finally, we analyze why this highly restricted adaptation can work, showing that majority-vote reliability improves with rollout consensus and that bias subspaces with greater accessible gradient energy exhibit stronger downstream trainability. These results demonstrate that substantial test-time adaptation can emerge from optimizing a tiny bias-only subspace using entirely label-free rewards.
translation:
标题：无标签引导：将测试时强化学习压缩至仅偏置子空间

摘要：测试时强化学习（TTRL）使模型无需依赖标注训练数据即可提升推理能力，但现有方法通常优化模型参数的很大一部分。这引出一个自然问题：当奖励信号和优化空间均受到严重限制时，能否产生有效的测试时自适应？我们通过无标签的仅偏置TTRL回答这一问题：该方法使用多数投票伪标签作为奖励，仅优化约10万个偏置参数，同时保持预训练主干网络冻结。在MATH-500上，我们的方法在Qwen2.5-7B上达到76.67%的准确率，略高于我们自己的有标签偏置引导复现结果，同时相比全参数TTRL优化的参数量减少了76,000倍。同一训练流程在视觉-语言和音频推理任务中均能提升性能，包括MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista和MMAU。我们进一步表明，学习到的引导向量可迁移至4,500个留出的MATH问题，说明这种自适应并不局限于测试时优化过程中所用的问题。最后，我们分析了这种高度受限的自适应为何能够奏效，表明多数投票的可靠性随rollout共识度提高而提升，并且具有更大可访问梯度能量的偏置子空间表现出更强的下游可训练性。这些结果表明，使用完全无标签的奖励优化一个极小的仅偏置子空间，即可产生显著的测试时自适应。

title: The Endless Exam: Mathematical Constructions from Today's Models toward Superintelligence
summary: We introduce the Endless Exam, a benchmark spanning fourteen parameterised families of mathematical construction problems, with verifiable scores that distinguish progress before and beyond published mathematical frontiers. Each submitted object is checked automatically for validity and assigned a relative quality score against a published frontier or construction baseline, without capping improvements at 1. The benchmark draws long-term challenges from open mathematical problems and generates larger instances by varying their parameters. Compact certificates allow large constructions to be verified without listing every element. Across nine models evaluated on 69 distinct instances, continuous quality scores distinguish performance even though none of the 30 published-frontier references is surpassed. Size-quality curves show how construction quality changes as problem size increases. We release the generators, verifiers, references, model responses and analysis to support continued measurement before and beyond human frontiers.

标题：无尽考试：从当前模型迈向超级智能的数学构造

摘要：我们提出“无尽考试”（The Endless Exam），这是一个涵盖十四个参数化数学构造问题族的基准，其可验证分数能够区分在已发表数学前沿之前以及超越该前沿的进展。每个提交对象都会被自动检查有效性，并相对于已发表前沿或构造基线获得一个相对质量分数，且改进不以 1 为上限。该基准从开放数学问题中提取长期挑战，并通过调整参数生成更大规模的实例。紧凑证书使得大型构造无需列出每个元素即可被验证。在 69 个不同实例上评估的九个模型中，连续质量分数能够区分模型表现，尽管 30 个已发表前沿参考均未被超越。规模—质量曲线展示了构造质量如何随问题规模增大而变化。我们发布生成器、验证器、参考、模型响应和分析，以支持在人类前沿之前及超越人类前沿的持续测量。

title: Safety of Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Latent communication enables multi-agent systems to exchange information directly in internal representation space, reducing the token, computation, and latency overhead of text-based communication. To this end, lightweight trainable links are introduced to map the sender's representations into the receiver's input space. In this work, we show that even benign link training can increase harmful compliance relative to text-based communication while the underlying safety-aligned agents remain unchanged. An attacker can amplify this effect by optimizing the links on harmful query--response pairs or poisoning otherwise benign training data. We further develop a reinforcement-learning attack that rewards harmful compliance alongside benign task performance without requiring harmful target responses. Across three communication topologies and four safety benchmarks, this attack raises the mean harmful-compliance score from 27.9 with benignly trained links to 76.9. Compared with direct supervised optimization, it also achieves higher average accuracy on two benign utility benchmarks. Adapting the rewards toward safer behavior also enables repair of compromised links, substantially reducing harmful compliance across all evaluated attacks without updating the agents. Overall, our results show that safety alignment requires considering the multi-agent system as a whole.

标题：多智能体系统中潜在通信的安全性

摘要：潜在通信使多智能体系统能够直接在内部表示空间中交换信息，从而降低基于文本的通信在词元、计算和延迟方面的开销。为此，引入轻量级可训练链路，将发送方的表示映射到接收方的输入空间。在本工作中，我们表明，即使良性的链路训练也会相对于基于文本的通信增加有害顺从，而底层安全对齐的智能体保持不变。攻击者可以通过在有害查询—响应对上优化链路，或对原本良性的训练数据进行投毒，来放大这一效应。我们进一步提出一种强化学习攻击，该攻击在奖励良性任务性能的同时奖励有害顺从，且不需要有害目标响应。在三种通信拓扑和四个安全基准上，该攻击将平均有害顺从分数从使用良性训练链路时的27.9提高到76.9。与直接监督优化相比，它在两个良性效用基准上也取得了更高的平均准确率。将奖励调整为更安全的行为还可以修复受损链路，在无需更新智能体的情况下，显著降低所有评估攻击中的有害顺从。总体而言，我们的结果表明，安全对齐需要将多智能体系统作为一个整体来考虑。
